let desk = { passed: 0, failed: 0, last: nil }
fn inspectLine(text) {
    let parsed = attempt(() => jsonParse(text))
    if parsed.ok { desk.passed = desk.passed + 1 } else { desk.failed = desk.failed + 1 }
    desk.last = parsed.value
    print(jsonStringify({ ok: parsed.ok, value: parsed.value }))
}
inspectLine("{\"id\":1}")
inspectLine("broken")
inspectLine("[2,3]")

print(kept)
print(jsonStringify(desk))

print("DESK_CONTINUES")
:reset
print(type(desk))
print("RESET_CONTINUES")
